brief: Prioritise Rushmere Junction 230/34kV for pre-event attention because it is an ageing unit with a history of high loading that has a reduced margin against mechanical failure (MG-023). Where this ageing unit cannot be attended before the heat event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure (MG-023). Reduce permissible load by 1.5 percent of rating for each degree of average ambient above 30 degrees, and apply a further 5 percent reduction from the third day onward on events extending beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees (MG-021).
